Rahu-Ketu grah hain… ya kuch aur? 🌑🌕 Amavasya har mahine aati hai, phir bhi har baar surya grahan kyun nahi lagta? 🤔 Jawab hai Moon ke raaste mein. Woh Suraj ke raaste se lagbhag 5° jhuka hua hai, isliye dono raaste sirf do points par milte hain. Grahan tabhi lagta hai jab Amavasya ya Purnima in do points ke paas pade. ✨ Jyotish parampara mein inhi do points ko Rahu aur Ketu kaha gaya. 🔭 Is reel mein: • Surya grahan vs chandra grahan • Chandra grahan mein Moon laal kyun dikh sakta hai • Poora andhera kitni der rehta hai: surya grahan mein lagbhag saadhe saat minute tak, chandra grahan mein lagbhag 1 ghanta 47 minute tak Toh Rahu-Ketu koi grah nahi, Moon ke raaste ke do points hain.
